text:
Type: small fringed flatwoven rug
Use: adding a soft accent by a bed or door; bedroom, bathroom, entryway, children's room
Style: coastal, Scandinavian, bohemian
Materials: flat weave in cotton-look yarn, knotted fringe at both ends
Colors: cobalt blue, white, space-dyed mix
Shape: small rectangle with streaky ikat-like texture, fringed short ends, thin and light, compact
Feel: fresh, breezy, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, light wood, blue and white textiles; coastal, Scandinavian or bohemian bedrooms and bathrooms

product.name: LAPPLJUNG
product.description: Easy to keep clean since it is machine washable.
